metadata.title: Brenen Thompson - Idle for Thursday's practice
metadata.analysis: Thompson has missed each of the first two practices of Week 3 prep while tending to a quadriceps injury, and he'll have one more opportunity to practice in at least a limited capacity ahead of Sunday's road game against the Bills. The rookie fourth-rounder has operated in a depth role through the first two games of the regular season, logging one catch (on three targets) for 13 yards in that span. Derius Davis and recent free agent signing Marquez Valdes-Scantling would see more involvement in the offense if Thompson is unable to play in Buffalo.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson - Dealing with quad issue
metadata.description: Thompson (quadriceps) did not participate at practice Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Thompson drew three targets in the Chargers' loss versus the Raiders in Week 2, but it appears he may have picked up a quad injury during that contest as well. He'll probably have to return to practice Thursday or Friday to give himself a chance to play in Week 3 at Buffalo.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) doesn't practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Brenen Thompson (quad) did not practice for the Chargers on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Thompson wasn't able to practice due to a quad issue on Wednesday. He seemed to play a real role in Los Angeles' offense last week, so if he has to miss time, Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris may see more work as a result of his absence.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson - Three targets in loss
metadata.description: Thompson caught one of his three targets for 13 yards in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Raiders.
metadata.analysis: Thompson's 13 offensive snaps were a distant third to the wide receivers ahead of him. Ladd McConkey logged 31 snaps, Quentin Johnston had 55 and Tre' Harris had 56. The wide receiver garnered some attention but was mainly used as a depth option.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson A Waiver-Wire Flier in Deep Leagues
metadata.description: Los Angeles Chargers rookie wide receiver Brenen Thompson saw only 10 snaps and was held off the stat sheet in his first career game, but with Ladd McConkey (rib) day-to-day with a rib injury, he is a player to at least consider on waivers in deeper leagues. As an undersized field-stretcher, Thompson is unlikely to command an every-down role even if McConkey is unable to suit up against the Raiders. Still, his big-play potential could be leaned on, and he has the opportunity to work his way into three-receiver sets alongside Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris. At RotoBaller's WR103, Thompson is not a player that needs to be actively targeted on waivers, but he is deserving of flier consideration in leagues with big-play bonuses.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson - Good to go for Week 1
metadata.description: Thompson (hip) doesn't carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
metadata.analysis: Thompson practiced fully Friday after limited sessions Wednesday and Thursday. The fourth-round rookie wideout is expected to see some action on special teams as a returner and should slot in as the Chargers' fourth receiver behind Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson (hip) good to go for Sunday
metadata.description: Brenen Thompson (hip) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
metadata.analysis: Thompson has been cleared to play for Sunday's game, meaning that his hip injury isn't a very serious issue at this point. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson - Tending to hip issue
metadata.description: Thompson (hip) was a limited participant at practice Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Thompson's injury was previously undisclosed, but it's now known that it's a hip injury that threatens to keep him out of Week 1 action. He'll likely have to practice in full Friday to avoid taking an injury designation going into the weekend.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson - Limited participant Wednesday
metadata.description: Thompson (undisclosed) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Thompson returned to practice Monday after missing the last two weeks with an undisclosed issue. The wide receiver's designation as limited in Wednesday's first official practice means he may be able to suit up for Sunday's regular-season opener against the Cardinals.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson (hip) limited Wednesday
metadata.description: Brenen Thompson (hip) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: The rookie was unable to log a full practice session on Wednesday due to a hip injury that he's dealing with. He has a chance to see the field on Sunday if active, but if he's ruled out, his absence will lead to a bit more work for Tre' Harris against the Arizona Cardinals.

metadata.title: Brenen Thompson - Returns to practice Monday
metadata.description: Thompson (undisclosed) was a participant in Monday's practice, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Thompson has returned to practice after missing the last two weeks with an undisclosed issue. It remains to be seen how the rest of Thompson's practice week will unfold, but there is a chance the fourth-round rookie could suit up for Sunday's opener against the Cardinals.
